sections.Profile:
"Diner," released by Williams in September 1990, is a pinball machine designed by Mark Ritchie with artwork by Mark Sprenger. This game immerses players in a 1950s-style diner setting, where the objective is to serve five customers: Haji, Babs, Boris, Pepe, and Buck. Players take on the role of a waitress, aiming to serve all customers to light the "Dine Time" jackpot.
